answer: Proof-of-Elapsed-Interval Gate.** An agent must keep a personal vault dormant for a randomized 24–72h window after each registration, proven by sequential timestamp co-signatures from independent clock sources. Activity before expiry is rejected. Honest agents tolerate the idle canyon; attackers pay it per identity, so registering N sybils costs N × mean-wait in wall-clock time and coordination overhead. A periodic mirror log lets challengers replay timestamp chains to flag overlapping intervals.
